description: Fetch a disaster record by ReliefWeb numeric ID including description, affected countries, GLIDE number, profile overview, key content links, and active appeals or response plans. Use after reliefweb_search_disasters to retrieve full details. Each curated list also has an archive, which the record leaves out. Two alternative selectors, at most one per call: sections names parts of the record to return, archive pages one list's archived entries in place of the record. Description and profile overview can together run to tens of KB for major disasters. A record over the response budget comes back as a section outline naming every section and its byte size. Nothing is truncated on any path.

archive.description: Archive mode: return a page of one curated list's ARCHIVED entries instead of the disaster record. The response carries the record identity, the selected list, and total / shown / offset, plus a next offset while more entries remain. Mutually exclusive with sections — sections slices the record, archive replaces it — and a call supplying both is rejected. A record over the response budget still answers an archive call with the page: a page is bounded by limit and carries none of the record prose, so it never outlines.

limit.description: Maximum archived entries in one page (1-100).

list.description: Which curated list to page. The archived entries of that list are the ones the profile itself leaves out.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first archived entry to return. Send back the nextOffset from the previous page to continue.

id.description: ReliefWeb numeric disaster ID. Obtained from reliefweb_search_disasters results.

sections.description: Sections of the disaster record to return, named by the sections[].name values an outline response lists. Omit for the whole record, or for a section outline when the record is over the response budget. Identity metadata — the record's ID, its name, and its canonical URL — comes back alongside whatever is requested. The call is self-contained — the record is re-fetched and sliced, so no prior call has to be repeated. This names parts of the record itself and never reaches archived entries — use archive for those.

items.description: A section name exactly as the outline response spelled it.

name: reliefweb_get_disaster

appealsResponsePlans.description: Currently-active appeals and response plans linked to this disaster — the present set. The archived entries are reachable with archive: { list: "appealsResponsePlans" }.

items.description: An appeal or response plan entry.

archive.description: One page of a curated list's archived entries, returned in place of the record.

entries.description: The archived entries in this page, in ReliefWeb's own archive order.

date.description: Publication date, carried by appeals and response plans.

list.description: The curated list this page was read from.

nextOffset.description: Offset to send back to read the next page. Absent when this page reaches the end of the archive.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first entry in this page.

shown.description: Number of entries in this page.

total.description: Total archived entries in that list for this record.

countries.description: All countries tagged on this disaster.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No disaster found with the given ID. `selector_conflict`: The call supplied both sections and archive, which select different things. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

keyContent.description: Currently-active curated key content links from the ReliefWeb editorial team — the present curated set. The archived entries are reachable with archive: { list: "keyContent" }.

kind.description: full when the record — or the sections asked for — is returned in whole; outline when the record exceeded the response budget and only its section index is returned; archive when the call asked for a page of one curated list's archived entries, which is returned in place of the record.

outlineNotice.description: How to re-call this tool for specific sections of the record.

profileOverview.description: Profile overview text from the ReliefWeb editorial team.

sections.description: Every section of the record, largest first. Pass the names back in `sections` to retrieve them.

items.description: One retrievable section of the record: its name and its serialized size.

bytes.description: Serialized byte size of the section

name.description: Section identifier — pass in `sections` to retrieve it

status.description: Disaster status: alert, ongoing, past, or alert-archive.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this disaster.

usefulLinks.description: Currently-active useful external links curated by ReliefWeb editors — the present set. The archived entries are reachable with archive: { list: "usefulLinks" }.

title: Get ReliefWeb Disaster
